content_of_post_to_answer: How do you distinguish between mastering an emotion and being controlled by it?
answer: The difference is not how intensely you feel an emotion, but how much freedom you retain while feeling it. Anger can be justified without dictating your response; fear can be useful without making every decision for you. Mastery doesn't mean suppressing an emotion or pretending it isn't there. It means being able to hear what it tells you without automatically obeying it. An emotion can deserve your attention without deserving control over your actions.
